description: Reviewed Ripio and World sources establish wARS identity, ARS reference, collateral attestation, platform conversion, multi-network distribution and Argentina World Money access, but do not resolve the exact legal issuing entity, direct holder claim/redemption terms, insolvency treatment, or authoritative contract addresses and mint-control details across all deployments.
